mapper.select:
SELECT a.TOUR_ID, a.TOUR_NM, a.TOUR_CONTENT, b1.CMM_CM_NM AS SIDO_NM, b2.CMM_CM_NM AS SGG_NM, a.ROAD_ADDR, a.DETAIL_ADDR, a.ZIP_CD, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.CATE_CD ORDER BY c.CATE_CD) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_CD,
( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY d.CMM_CM_NM) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D ON c.CATE_CD = d.CMM_CDV AND d.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b1 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,'00000000') = b1.CMM_CDV AND b1.CMM_CD_ID = 'SIDO_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b2 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,a.SGG_CD,'00000') = b2.CMM_CDV AND b2.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' WHERE a.TOUR_ID = #{tourId}

SELECT a.TOUR_ID, a.FIRST_IMAGE, a.TOUR_NM, a.TOUR_CONTENT, a.TOUR_CONTENT AS OVERVIEW, a.MAP_Y AS LATITUDE, a.MAP_X AS LONGITUDE, a.TOUR_NM_EN, a.TOUR_NM_JA, a.TOUR_CONTENT_EN AS OVERVIEW_EN, a.TOUR_CONTENT_JA AS OVERVIEW_JA, b1.CMM_CDV AS SIDO_CD, b1.CMM_CM_NM AS SIDO_NM, b2.CMM_CDV AS SGG_CD, b2.CMM_CM_NM AS SGG_NM, a.ROAD_ADDR, a.DETAIL_ADDR, a.ZIP_CD, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.CATE_CD ORDER BY c.CATE_CD) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_CD,
( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY d.CMM_CM_NM) FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D d ON c.CATE_CD = d.CMM_CDV AND d.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' WHERE c.TOUR_ID = a.TOUR_ID ) AS CATE_NM, IFNULL(c.AVG_SCORE,0) AS AVG_SCORE FROM TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b1 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,'00000000') = b1.CMM_CDV AND b1.CMM_CD_ID = 'SIDO_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b2 ON CONCAT(a.SIDO_CD,a.SGG_CD,'00000') = b2.CMM_CDV AND b2.CMM_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOUR_ID, AVG(REVIEW_SCORE) AS AVG_SCORE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW GROUP BY TOUR_ID ) c ON a.TOUR_ID = c.TOUR_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.TOUR_ID = #{tourId}

SELECT b.MOIM_TITLE , b.MOIM_START_DT , b.MOIM_END_DT , a.REVIEW_TITLE , a.REVIEW_CONTENT , a.REVIEW_SCORE , a.IMG_URLS , a.CREATE_DT , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(c.USER_NM) = 1 THEN '*' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(c.USER_NM) = 2 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(c.USER_NM, 1), '*') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(c.USER_NM, 1), '***', RIGHT(c.USER_NM, 1)) END AS USER_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST b ON a.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO c ON a.CREATE_USER = c.USER_ID WHERE a.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'T' AND a.TOUR_ID = #{tourId} ORDER BY a.CREATE_DT DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}
